about: Where each agent's hook contract was checked (Pulse reads no vendor file). Gate: scripts/catalog_check.py. Weekly sentinel: scripts/vendor_drift.py.

hooks.note: Every Pulse entry runs async: true — an async hook cannot block or decide ("Run hooks in the background"). PostToolUse is activity (tool_name + tool_input: the step); PostToolUseFailure (after a tool call fails; output cannot change the outcome) is activity too. UserPromptSubmit's prompt is the session's title. Stop's last_assistant_message is the last words; StopFailure's last_assistant_message / error_details / error is the turn's error. PermissionDenied is not installed: its hookSpecificOutput.retry can change what the model does. PermissionRequest AskUserQuestion reads tool_input.questions[0].question; ExitPlanMode reads tool_input.plan. Inside a subagent each event carries `agent_id`, written as the line's sub column (a subagent never answers the main agent's block, never revives an ended turn and is never the person's prompt).

hooks.json only — Pulse never touches config.toml (no notify argv). hooks.json shares Claude's nested shape and honours async (SessionEnd always runs synchronously, capped at 3 s). PermissionRequest is never installed: it fires before Codex's own auto-review. Stop is the end of a turn (last_assistant_message: the last words); UserPromptSubmit's prompt is the title. PostToolUse is installed async (engine/discovery.rs: only SessionEnd is forced synchronous; an async handler's output is never read) — the per-tool activity that makes a stall meaningful, and the step. Inside a subagent each event carries `agent_id`, written as the line's sub column (a subagent never answers the main agent's block, never revives an ended turn and is never the person's prompt).

cursor.com was unreachable from the build environment on 2026-09-29; event names and payload fields (conversation_id, workspace_roots, status) were cross-checked against third-party typed bindings (pkg.go.dev/github.com/Checkmarx/ast-cx-hooks/cursor, github.com/speakeasy-api/gram server/design/hooks). beforeSubmitPrompt can stop a prompt and is not installed. Re-read the docs on a machine that can reach them. No installed event names a tool, so a Cursor row has no steps.

Pinned at 8efd314 (2026-10-16). User extensions load from getAgentDir()/extensions — ~/.pi/agent unless PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR moves it (src/config.ts); Pulse, a GUI app, follows no environment and installs to ~/.pi/agent, and Settings says so when that folder is missing on a Mac where Pi is present. Extension events are notifications when the handler returns nothing; before_agent_start, input, tool_call, tool_result, turn_end, message_end, user_bash and session_before_switch/fork/compact/tree can change what Pi does and are never subscribed. The extension sends nothing when ctx.mode is json or print (subagents run as pi --mode json -p --no-session, examples/extensions/subagent). Each event is one pulse-hook child, spawned only after the previous one exited (1.5 s guard; queue of 64, a block, its answer, the turn's end and the shutdown dropped last; flushed on session_shutdown), so lines are numbered in emission order. ui_prompt_start/ui_prompt_end (reason ui_prompt, kind, title) come from ExtensionRunner.withUIPrompt (runner.ts): confirm is a permission, select/input/editor a question (interactive-mode.ts setBlocked), custom is not a block and is an ignored line. Pi's own blocks that do not pass through it — the /login OAuth wait and the missing-session-cwd confirm (promptForMissingSessionCwd) — are not reported. tool_execution_start is sent as a status line (tool + one argument: command for bash/powershell, path for read/edit/write/ls, pattern for grep/find, else a fallback list) and its argument kept by toolCallId for tool_execution_end, which carries isError and durationMs (sent as is_error/duration_ms) but no args; calls with parentToolCallId (nested calls a tool made) are not sent. message_start is sent for role user only; a skill block (<skill name=… location=…>…</skill>, agent-session.ts parseSkillBlock) is sent as /skill:name args, never the skill path. session_start carries getSessionName(); session_info_changed (setSessionName) carries the new name. agent_settled carries aborted (an Escape: a stopped line); otherwise the run's last assistant words or errorMessage from agent_end (observed, never sent). The extension sends process.pid (accepted only as the hook's own parent) and no transcript path. Pi sets process.title to pi / pi-rpc (cli/setup.ts, rpc-entry.ts), which on macOS leaves argv ["pi", "", …] under node.

camelCase event names select the camelCase payload. notification is fire-and-forget; agentStop/sessionStart outputs are ignored when stdout is empty. agent_idle/agent_completed describe background subagents and are not read as the session's turn. postToolUse / postToolUseFailure: empty output keeps the original result ("Return {} or empty output"); only exit 2 on postToolUseFailure adds context, and Pulse exits 0 — the tool ran, which answers a permission_prompt. postToolUse sends toolArgs as a JSON string; its command or path is the step's target. userPromptSubmitted's prompt is the title. An unrecoverable errorOccurred ends the turn with error.message as its error. Inside a subagent each event carries `agentId`, written as the line's sub column (a subagent never answers the main agent's block, never revives an ended turn and is never the person's prompt).

A legacy plugin module: every named export is a plugin function. Only the event hook is used; it never throws and never awaits the child it spawns. session.error forwards the error's message (the turn's error). No installed event names a tool or carries a prompt: an OpenCode row has no steps and no title from its events.
